thread:
tess: heads up — escalated from acme-42. They send stream requests and see an intermittent broken-pipe after ~15-25s. On their side it looks like a 502 and they’re getting token double-billing alerts because we count it as a 5xx.
ashwin: do we have sample request ids / gateway node?
tess: yep — request_id=rid_0a1b2c, gw=gw-us-3. I pulled the gateway log and the runtime logs. Gateway shows: 'write failed: broken pipe', runtime shows final tokens generated and then a TCP FIN from client.
kevin: interesting — sounds like client-initiated close (or mobile conn churn) but the gateway is mapping to 502. nginx/traefik usually gives 499 when client closes. Are we normalizing 499 -> 5xx somewhere?
lucy: quick paste of the raw lines from gw-us-3: ```
[2026-04-22T18:14:02Z] rid_0a1b2c INFO proxy: upstream=runtime-12 status=200 bytes=1342
[2026-04-22T18:14:02Z] rid_0a1b2c ERROR proxy: write failed: broken pipe
[2026-04-22T18:14:02Z] rid_0a1b2c INFO proxy: connection closed by client
```
ashwin: thanks. Runtime returned OK, we finished streaming. The broken pipe is gateway trying to push remaining chunk but client already closed. If our gateway treats that as an upstream failure it becomes a 5xx in our metrics.
tess: customer repro steps attached. They run this from a flaky mobile network and interrupt the stream after ~20s. Repro curl (they used): ```bash
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_redwood" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"hello","stream":true}' \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" && sleep 8 && pkill -INT curl
```
kevin: can reproduce locally by killing the client after a few seconds. Gateway logs show the write syscall EPIPE/ECONNRESET. Right now our metric pipeline counts any gateway ERROR with 'write failed' as 5xx. That's the bug.
lucy: is this also affecting billing events? Customer says they were billed for tokens twice because client retried.
ashwin: two separate issues: 1) misclassification (counts as 5xx) 2) customer retry policy leads to double-processing. For (1) I can patch the metric mapper to treat client-closed socket errors as non-5xx (map to 499 or ignore). For (2) we should recommend idempotency or 'operation' header — but streaming calls are hard.
oncall-bot: Incident IN-2026-0422 created by tess — priority P2.
tess: suggested playbook: immediate — patch metric producer to exclude 'write failed: broken pipe' from 5xx counts and stop alerting on customer. short term config change: treat EPIPE/EINVAL/EHOSTUNREACH as client close. mid term: change gateway mapping so client-initiated closes produce 499 and never increment 5xx counters.
kevin: I can put a canary rule in gw-us-3 to map write errors to 499 for streaming endpoints. Will push small config change and deploy to one node.
lucy: I'll open ticket RWD-3812 and link to billing team for potential credits: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWD-3812. Include affected accounts list (acme-42 + 4 others).
ashwin: instrumentation note — add tagging to logs for 'client_closed=true' when we detect EPIPE. That will help future audits. Also add a regression test in the infra-integration suite: simulate client early close and assert metric delta is zero for 5xx.
tess: customer update drafted: "We identified the issue: some client-initiated disconnects during streaming were being counted as server errors. We're rolling a gateway fix to stop those from generating 5xx and to prevent erroneous billing/alerts. We'll follow up once deployed and credit affected calls if needed." :thumbsup:
kevin: deploying canary now to gw-us-3-node-7. Will post logs.
kevin: canary deployed — initial run shows the same repro results but metric now labels it 499 and our 5xx chart stays flat.
lucy: thanks — I've notified billing to hold any automated chargebacks and to queue manual review for affected customers.
ashwin: next steps: (a) roll mapping change to all prod, (b) add log tag and integrate the regression test, (c) small doc note in support runbook about streaming retries and idempotency.
tess: thanks team. I'll close the support thread after we roll to prod and confirm billing credits.
kevin: FYI — linked PR for metric mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/492 (commented).
oncall-bot: Incident IN-2026-0422 status: investigating -> mitigation deployed -> monitoring.
